The key information I found is that [cite: concepts/workloads/autoscaling/horizontal-pod-autoscale#container-resource-metrics-0] the HPA can track individual containers. The ticket mentions version 4.8.0 was released last Tuesday. Looking at the pod logs, I noticed that the pods have two containers: `api` and `log-forwarder`. The log-forwarder container does NOT have CPU requests specified.

Let me search for more information about how HPA calculates metrics when containers don't have requests.
